title: Consolidate VPC module interfaces and bump AWS provider to v4
creator: Lina Gomez
description: We have three slightly-different VPC/networking modules and multiple environment-specific networking templates (staging/prod/us/eu) that diverged over time. This ticket consolidates the interface (inputs/outputs) of core VPC modules into a single, opinionated module with compatibility shims, and updates our Terraform AWS provider from 3.x to 4.x across shared modules and CI stacks. Goals: reduce cognitive overhead for new stacks, remove duplicated code paths, and unlock provider features/fixes in v4 that resolve subtle lifecycle issues we see in CI plans.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical vpc module exists under modules/network/vpc with clear inputs/outputs and documented migration notes
All stacks (hosted-api, dedicated, private) successfully plan and apply against a staging workspace without drift
Terraform AWS provider bumped to >=4.0.0 in shared modules and pipeline images; no provider incompatibility errors remain
Automated terratest suite (network smoke tests) passes in CI for us-east-1 and eu-west-1
State migration steps documented and dry-run validated; minimal manual state edits required and rollback documented
tasks: Audit existing VPC/networking modules and collect deviations (inputs, outputs, resource names, tags)
Design canonical module interface and compatibility shim mapping for legacy inputs
Implement consolidated module and move duplicated templates to module wrappers
Update all calling stacks to use new module (initially via module alias to support canary) in staging
Bump aws provider to v4 in root modules and CI images; run terraform init/plan across workspaces
Create migration playbook: terraform state mv commands, import steps for cross-account resources
Add/extend terratest network checks and run in CI for two regions
Monitor staging apply for 72 hours, gather drift/alerts, then schedule production rollout
updates: 2025-03-04: Created ticket and uploaded initial audit notes. Collected module diffs from us/repo and eu/repo.
2025-03-07: Design review with networking and platform teams; agreed to keep labels and naming stable and add compatibility shims for legacy stacks.

2025-03-11: Initial consolidated module committed to feature branch; basic terratest added. CI Terraform init failed due to provider v3->v4 breaking change for sts_assume_role duration default — identified change required in caller stacks.
2025-03-14: Provider bump patch prepared and tested in ephemeral workspace; created migration playbook with state mv examples and safety checklist.
2025-03-18: Started staged rollout to staging workspaces in us-east-1. Observability dashboard created to track apply time, drift, and provider errors. No customer-facing incidents observed so far.
notes: Migration risks: cross-account VPC peering resources require careful state moves. We will perform state operations during a maintenance window with an ops engineer and keep quick rollback plan to re-point stacks to legacy module alias. Refs: ticket runbook attached in Confluence link. CI will gate production rollout until terratest passes in both regions.
rollback_plan: If staging reveals regressions, revert stacks to the legacy module by setting module source to modules/network/vpc_legacy and re-running terraform apply. For provider regressions, pin provider to 3.x in the root until migration PRs are resolved.
testing_strategy: Unit-level: terraform validate + terraform fmt in pre-commit. Integration: terratest network connectivity and tagging checks in CI. Manual: apply in staging followed by smoke deploys for control plane components that rely on networking.
